simple.meaning: Gichon , a river of Paradise; also a valley (or pool) near Jerusalem
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to גִּיחוֹן (H1521) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.

simple.summary: גִּיחוֹן (Gîychôwn) means Gichon , a river of Paradise; also a valley (or pool) near Jerusalem First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 1 33.

definitions.short: Gichon , a river of Paradise; also a valley (or pool) near Jerusalem
definitions.full: H1521. Gichon גִּיחוֺן proper name, of a river ( a bursting forth ) — 1 one of the rivers of Eden Gen 2:13 (on theories of identity see Commentaries; also Smith Dict. Bible Schaff-Herzog Art. Eden Spurrell Text of Gen. on the passage Ri HWB ). 2 spring of water near Jerusalem : גִּחוֺן 1Kin 1:33 , 38 , 45 , הָעֶלְיוֺן גִיחוֺן מֵימֵי 2Chr 32:30 , בַּנַּחַל לְגִיחוֺן 33:14 ; — there are two main theories as to locality: a. west of Jerusalem, connected with Birket Mamilla , and aqueduct into city Rob BR i. 239, 345 ff. Survey Jerusalem and others; b. east of Jerusalem = Fountain of the Virgin, Furrer Schenkel BL ii. 483 Bd Pal 101 , or Siloah water-system Guthe ZPV, v., 1882, 359 ff . גֵּיחֲזִי see below גַּיְא .
